own_solution.law: m_w c (dTw - T) = m_i L + m_i c T; Q = m_w c (dTw - T)
assumptions: insulated container, only ice and water exchange heat

defect_reasons.other: T96AB (and its twin T32CB) say 'the water' without naming the container while the scene has warm water in two containers; the context makes the first container the natural reading.

notes: The authors' relations are equivalent to mine: dTf = (Qw - Qm)/((mi+mw)c). Checks: dTw = 40 K: T = 23.477 K, Q = 34.582 kJ; 46 K: T = 28.650 K, Q = 36.314 kJ; 57 K: T = 38.132 K, Q = 39.490 kJ; 69 K: T = 48.477 K, Q = 42.954 kJ; all match, and all ice melts in every case. Minimal pairs hold: T32CB vs T96AB differ only 'Before the ice was added' -> 'In an earlier run'; TA38E vs T5D2A differ only 'first' -> 'second' container; same 17 K. T2F5B and T162D are declared numeral-free twins by design. Agrees with my pass 1; the only flag is the low-severity wording point.
